candidates.source_name: ÚOHS – Sbírky rozhodnutí (veřejné zakázky)
candidates.why_relevant: Full-text searchable collection of legally effective ÚOHS decisions on public procurement (published under §272 ZZVZ, ~16k+ decisions from 1999). Contested banking-services, card-acquiring, ATM and core-banking IT tenders surface here with contracting authority, bidders, prices and the exact grounds of complaint — the richest narrative detail available on CZ banking/payment tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the sbirky-rozhodnuti search form with keyword filters (bankovní služby, platební, platební karty, akceptace karet, bankomat) and paginate detail pages; PDFs linked per decision. Polite rate limiting; no API observed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query on ÚOHS decision database
queries_used: ÚOHS rozhodnutí veřejná zakázka bankovní služby námitky sbírka rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚOHS – Sborníky rozhodnutí (sectoral decision digests)
candidates.why_relevant: Curated sector digests of ÚOHS procurement decisions (e.g. healthcare 01/2021–06/2024, telecommunications/telematics 01/2021–12/2023). A banking/IT-flavoured digest, or the telecom/IT one, gives pre-filtered, thematically grouped case law — a shortcut into where the disputed tech tenders are.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the page for new PDF sborníky; parse case IDs and cross-link to the sbírka rozhodnutí detail pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ÚOHS decision search results
queries_used: ÚOHS rozhodnutí veřejná zakázka bankovní služby námitky sbírka rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚOHS – Tiskové zprávy: veřejné zakázky
candidates.why_relevant: Press releases flag the decisions ÚOHS itself considers significant, often weeks before the full text appears in the collection. Precedent: the joint ÚOHS–MMR position on concluding banking-service contracts after Sberbank CZ's collapse left public authorities without a bank — a direct market-opening signal for banking tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the press-release index page (or RSS if exposed) daily; keyword-filter on bankovní, platební, IT, informační systém.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search, snowballed from decision-database results
queries_used: ÚOHS rozhodnutí veřejná zakázka bankovní služby námitky sbírka rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚOHS – Návrh na přezkoumání úkonů zadavatele (procedural pages)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains the complaint pipeline (námitky → návrh → rozhodnutí → rozklad → správní soud), which defines the terminology, deposit rules and time windows a collector must model to know when a contested banking tender becomes visible and how long it stalls.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch for glossary/ontology building; re-check annually or after ZZVZ amendments.
queries_used: ÚOHS rozhodnutí veřejná zakázka bankovní služby námitky sbírka rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: Hlídač státu – Databáze rozhodnutí ÚOHS
candidates.why_relevant: Independent NGO mirror of ÚOHS decisions in a structured, queryable dataset, cross-linked to Hlídač's contract register, company and tender datasets. Far easier to bulk-query than the ÚOHS site, and it joins a decision to the actual signed contract and supplier.
candidates.legal_status: re-publication of public data; check Hlídač terms and attribution rules
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the Hlídač API v2 (docs at /api/v1/doc) with an account token; incremental pulls by date, keyword-filter for banking/payment terms.
queries_used: ÚOHS sbírka rozhodnutí ISVZ open data API rozhodnutí veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (MMR) – Databáze rozhodnutí / Vybraná rozhodnutí od 2020
candidates.why_relevant: The ministry's own monthly 'Vybraná rozhodnutí ÚOHS' PDFs summarise the decisions the state considers precedent-setting, including administrative-court reviews. A compact monthly feed that tells you which contested tenders mattered without reading thousands of rulings.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the 'Vybraná rozhodnutí' listing; download and text-extract PDFs, index case numbers.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search + snowball from ÚOHS results
queries_used: ÚOHS sbírka rozhodnutí ISVZ open data API rozhodnutí veřejné zakázky
Nejvyšší správní soud rozhodnutí přezkum ÚOHS veřejná zakázka databáze rozhodnutí nssoud

candidates.source_name: Nejvyšší správní soud – vyhledávač rozhodnutí
candidates.why_relevant: Judicial review layer above ÚOHS: when a bank or IT vendor loses at ÚOHS it appeals to Krajský soud v Brně and then NSS. These judgments reveal the final outcome, the commercial stakes, and often more factual detail about the tender than the regulator's own text.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the vyhledavac by keyword (zadavatel, ÚOHS, bankovní služby, platební karty) and by ÚOHS case reference; fetch the HTML DokumentOriginal pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search on judicial review of ÚOHS
queries_used: Nejvyšší správní soud rozhodnutí přezkum ÚOHS veřejná zakázka databáze rozhodnutí nssoud

candidates.source_name: ÚOHS – rozsudky VZ (court judgments republished by ÚOHS)
candidates.why_relevant: ÚOHS hosts the judgments reviewing its own procurement decisions (including Constitutional Court rulings) under a rozsudky_VZ download path, giving a single place to pair regulator decision with court outcome.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Follow download.php?q=sbirky_rozhodnuti/rozsudky_VZ/... links harvested from decision detail pages; PDF text extraction.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from search result link structure
queries_used: Nejvyšší správní soud rozhodnutí přezkum ÚOHS veřejná zakázka databáze rozhodnutí nssoud

candidates.source_name: NKÚ – kontrolní závěry (audit conclusions)
candidates.why_relevant: Supreme Audit Office conclusions are public and unappealable, and routinely dissect payment-agenda and IT projects: e.g. KA 17/22 on MPSV benefit-payment agenda and system-integration services (explicitly assessing ZZVZ compliance), KA 16/30 on state treasury liquidity, KA 14/20 on the National Data Centre. They expose vendor lock-in, cost overruns and mismanaged banking/payment procurement in detail no tender notice contains.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the kontrolní akce index and the /assets/kon-zavery/kNNNNN.pdf pattern; PDF text extraction; keyword filter on platební, banka, bankovní účet, informační systém, státní pokladna.
queries_used: NKÚ kontrolní závěr platební systém informační systém veřejné prostředky

candidates.source_name: Věstník NKÚ
candidates.why_relevant: The NKÚ bulletin carries the annual audit plan (which upcoming audits are scheduled) plus the published conclusions. The plan is forward-looking: knowing an audit of a payment or treasury system is scheduled predicts where remediation procurement will follow.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch each částka PDF as issued (URL pattern /assets/publikace-a-dokumenty/vestnik/vestnik-nku-YYYY-castka-N.pdf); parse plán kontrolní činnosti entries.
queries_used: NKÚ kontrolní závěr platební systém informační systém veřejné prostředky

candidates.source_name: NKÚ – informace z kontrolních akcí (press summaries)
candidates.why_relevant: Short 'informace z kontrolní akce' summaries are published alongside the full conclusions and are the fastest low-cost trigger for deciding whether to pull the full PDF.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the press-release listing / RSS; the /assets/media/informace-NN-NN.pdf pattern holds the summaries.
queries_used: NKÚ kontrolní závěr platební systém informační systém veřejné prostředky

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Seznamy a evidence (lists and registers of regulated entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative entry point to every CZ licensed bank, payment institution, e-money institution, small-scale payment service provider and account information service provider. New licences identify the payment actors likely to bid for public banking/acquiring contracts or to be acquired; withdrawn licences explain sudden tender re-runs (cf. Sberbank).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as index page; actual entity data via JERRS application and WS JERRS web services rather than HTML scraping.
queries_used: ČNB seznam regulovaných subjektů registr platebních institucí JERRS

candidates.source_name: ČNB JERRS – Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů (+ WS JERRS web services)
candidates.why_relevant: The machine-queryable licence register: search by name or IČO, with the full status history — licence granted, amended, withdrawn, with dates. This is the cleanest structured feed for detecting new payment actors and licence changes, and WS JERRS web services have exposed selected data since 1 July 2019.
candidates.access_status: public, free; legacy Oracle-portal UI, session-based
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer WS JERRS web services (SOAP/REST) for scheduled delta pulls keyed on IČO and licence date; fall back to the JERRS web UI only for manual verification. Session-parameterised URLs make naive scraping fragile.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query, snowball to WS JERRS
queries_used: ČNB seznam regulovaných subjektů registr platebních institucí JERRS

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Supervision of payment institutions and e-money institutions (EN)
candidates.why_relevant: English-language statement of supervisory scope over payment institutions, EMIs, small-scale payment service providers and small-scale e-money issuers — the category ontology needed to interpret the Czech register and to map CZ categories onto EU (PSD2/EBA) equivalents.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch for taxonomy mapping; re-check on PSD3/regulatory change.
queries_used: CNB report on financial market supervision English payment institutions register open data

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Financial Market Supervision Report (annual, CS/EN)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual narrative on licensing activity, enforcement, sanctions and structural change in the CZ banking and payments sector. Aggregates entrant/exit counts and supervisory priorities — context for why particular institutions appear or vanish from public tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download (fms_YYYY.pdf pattern under the export/sites/cnb galleries path); text extraction of licensing/enforcement chapters.
queries_used: CNB report on financial market supervision English payment institutions register open data
local_language_terms_used: Zpráva o výkonu dohledu nad finančním trhem

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Seznamy institucí pro potřeby měnové a finanční statistiky
candidates.why_relevant: Statistical institution lists (MFIs etc.) provide a second, differently-maintained identifier set for CZ banks and financial institutions — useful for entity resolution when matching tender bidders to licensed entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic download of the published lists (typically XLS/CSV); use for IČO ↔ institution-code crosswalk.

candidates.source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (NKOD) – ČNB datasets
candidates.why_relevant: The national open-data catalogue lists ČNB register datasets (e.g. the list of tied agents under the consumer-credit act, publisher IČO 48136450) with machine-readable distributions — the discovery layer for which regulator registers are downloadable in bulk rather than only browsable.
candidates.legal_status: open data, licence stated per dataset
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the NKOD SPARQL/REST catalogue for publishers ČNB, ÚOHS, NKÚ, MF, ÚOOÚ; enumerate distributions and schedule direct downloads.

candidates.source_name: ÚOOÚ – ukončené kontroly (completed inspections), banking and financial sector
candidates.why_relevant: Inspection reports naming specific banks (UniCredit Bank CZ&SK, GE Money Bank) and citing the payments act (zák. č. 370/2017 Sb. o platebním styku). They reveal which data-processing and client-communication technologies banks actually run, and compliance failures that trigger remediation procurement in security/IT.
candidates.legal_status: official publication (some documents released under FOI)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the year-indexed 'kontroly za rok NNNN' pages; note the site migrated from uoou.cz to uoou.gov.cz, so maintain both URL patterns and treat old uoou.cz links as legacy/possibly redirecting.

candidates.source_name: ÚOOÚ – povinně zveřejňované informace / poskytnuté informace (FOI disclosures)
candidates.why_relevant: FOI-released inspection protocols and information on administrative proceedings in the banking and financial sector contain operational detail (systems, vendors, processes) that is not in the summarised public reports.
candidates.legal_status: released under the CZ freedom-of-information act
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /media/poskytnute-informace/ year folders for PDFs; OCR where scanned; keyword-filter on banka, platební, kartové.
queries_used: Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů rozhodnutí kontrola banky platební styk zpráva o činnosti

candidates.source_name: MF ČR – Metodický pokyn CHJ č. 3 (Metodika veřejného nakupování) a metodické materiály
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Finance central-harmonisation-unit guidance on public buying (3E principles), updated in v2.0 (Dec 2024) in line with the National Public Procurement Strategy 2024–2028. It sets the evaluation logic contracting authorities are told to apply — i.e. how a banking-services or payment-terminal bid will actually be judged.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the metodické materiály listing plus mf.gov.cz/assets/attachments PDF drops; version-diff successive releases of MP CHJ č. 3.
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí metodika bankovní služby zadávání veřejných zakázek státní pokladna metodické pokyny

candidates.source_name: Státní pokladna (MF) – metodické informace / CSÚIS
candidates.why_relevant: The State Treasury programme is itself a large, continuously procured payment/accounting IT estate (CSÚIS, IISSP). Its methodological bulletins signal system changes, interface obligations on public bodies, and hence upcoming integration and payment-infrastructure contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the metodické informace listing for new items; the domain migrated from statnipokladna.cz to statnipokladna.gov.cz, so keep both patterns.
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí metodika bankovní služby zadávání veřejných zakázek státní pokladna metodické pokyny

candidates.source_name: ISVZ / NIPEZ – Informační systém o veřejných zakázkách (open data & dashboards)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory procurement information system (§224 zák. č. 134/2016 Sb.) publishes market datasets, dashboards and OpenData. It is the structural backbone against which regulator-side signals (ÚOHS decisions, NKÚ audits) can be joined to actual notices and awards.
candidates.source_subtype: statutory procurement information system / open data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the OpenData exports on schedule; filter by CPV codes for financial and IT services; join on IČO to ÚOHS/JERRS entities.

candidates.source_name: Wolters Kluwer ASPI – Expertní databáze rozhodnutí ÚOHS ve věci veřejných zakázek
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial, editorially enriched database of ÚOHS procurement decisions with legal tagging and cross-references to case law — valuable for precision retrieval of banking-services precedent, but paywalled.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape. Consider a licensed seat for manual analyst lookups only; rely on the free ÚOHS collection for automated collection.
queries_used: ÚOHS rozhodnutí veřejná zakázka bankovní služby námitky sbírka rozhodnutí

negative_findings.description: No banking- or payments-specific ÚOHS 'sborník rozhodnutí' was found. The published sectoral digests cover healthcare (01/2021–06/2024) and telecommunications/telematics (01/2021–12/2023), plus construction, but not financial services.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sector digests exist but none for banking/payments; banking-related rulings must be found by keyword search across the general decision collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must rely on full-text keyword retrieval with a well-built Czech glossary rather than a curated sector feed, raising both recall risk and noise.

negative_findings.description: No official ÚOHS machine API for the decision collection was identified in searches; the accessible structured route is the third-party Hlídač státu dataset/API, whose original-source field points at the legacy uohs.cz path.
negative_findings.result_summary: Official access appears to be HTML search form plus per-decision PDFs only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection depends either on scraping a legacy search form or on an NGO intermediary, creating a single point of failure and a lag/completeness risk.

negative_findings.description: Both ÚOOÚ (uoou.cz → uoou.gov.cz) and Státní pokladna (statnipokladna.cz → statnipokladna.gov.cz) appear mid-migration, with old and new URLs both circulating in search results. ÚOHS likewise moved from uohs.cz to uohs.gov.cz.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy URLs still returned by search engines; not verified whether they redirect or 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Stored URLs will rot; a 404 on a legacy path must be treated as 'moved', not 'dead source'. Collectors should normalise to the .gov.cz hosts and re-resolve legacy links.

negative_findings.description: ČNB JERRS is served from a legacy Oracle web portal with session/login-style URL parameters (JERRS.WEB45.LOGIN_A?p_lang=cz&p_err=8) rather than clean permalinks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public and free, but not permalink-friendly; WS JERRS web services are the documented machine route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive HTML scraping of JERRS will be brittle and may look 'blocked' when it is merely session-based. Not verified whether WS JERRS requires registration.

negative_findings.description: The exact WS JERRS web-service endpoint, its schema and any registration requirement were not located within this run; only the existence of the service (since 1 July 2019) was established from secondary description.
negative_findings.result_summary: Service known to exist; endpoint not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-value structured licensing feed for this cell is not yet technically specified, so the collection plan for it remains provisional.

negative_findings.description: No ÚOOÚ material was found that ties personal-data enforcement directly to a public procurement process; the banking-sector inspections concern banks as data controllers, not as tender participants.
negative_findings.result_summary: ÚOOÚ is a weak tender-adjacent signal compared with ÚOHS and NKÚ.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting ÚOOÚ in the collection plan; it is best used as vendor/technology intelligence and compliance-driven demand signal, not as a tender source.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional-level oversight bodies were not covered: Ministerstvo financí's financial-control/audit arm over territorial units, krajské úřady audit outputs, and Krajský soud v Brně (first-instance reviewer of ÚOHS procurement decisions, below NSS).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a pass on Krajský soud v Brně judgments (justice.cz / infosoud) and MF public-finance-control reports; Krajský soud is the missing middle tier between ÚOHS and NSS.

coverage_gaps.description: The CZ glossary built here is strong on procurement-procedure terms but thin on payments-domain tender vocabulary (e.g. akceptace platebních karet, platební terminály, bankomaty, kartové centrum, zpracování transakcí, jádrový bankovní systém).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the keyword set with acquiring/terminal/ATM/core-banking Czech terms plus English-in-Czech usage (POS, ATM, acquiring, core banking) and re-run full-text searches over the ÚOHS collection and ISVZ open data.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level regulator/audit layers adjacent to this cell were not scouted: EBA payment institutions register, ECB/SSM lists, European Court of Auditors, and TED/EU procurement remedies — all of which cover CZ entities and cross-border bidders.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up cell or extend this one to EBA/ECB registers and ECA reports for cross-border payment actors likely to bid in CZ.

coverage_gaps.description: No assessment was made of publication lag: how long after a decision or audit becomes effective it appears in the ÚOHS collection, the NKÚ Věstník, or JERRS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During the first collection cycles, measure decision-date vs publication-date deltas per source and record them as freshness metadata.

coverage_gaps.description: Reuse terms were not established for the NGO aggregator (Hlídač státu) or confirmed per-dataset on NKOD.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read Hlídač státu API terms and NKOD per-dataset licence fields before building dependent pipelines; prefer primary regulator sources where licence is unambiguous.

brief: The Czech tender-adjacent regulatory layer is unusually well documented and almost entirely open: ÚOHS publishes a full-text collection of procurement decisions from 1999 (~16k+), with curated sector digests, press releases flagging significant cases, and the reviewing court judgments republished alongside; NKÚ publishes unappealable audit conclusions plus a forward-looking annual audit plan in its Věstník, repeatedly covering payment-agenda and treasury IT projects. ČNB's JERRS register — with WS JERRS web services since July 2019 — is the authoritative feed for new, amended and withdrawn payment-institution and e-money licences, the best early indicator of who will bid for or buy into public banking contracts. ÚOOÚ is a weaker but non-trivial signal (bank inspections revealing systems and compliance failures), and MF's CHJ methodology plus the Státní pokladna/CSÚIS feed define how bids are evaluated and where treasury-side payment procurement is heading. Main technical risks are the absence of an official ÚOHS API (forcing reliance on scraping or the Hlídač státu mirror), a legacy session-based JERRS UI, and three concurrent .cz → .gov.cz domain migrations that will rot stored URLs.
